description: Vortix's Principality of Antioch (Serjeants) and the Kingdom of Castile (Genitour) build. This strategy focuses on a potent mid-game composition of Serjeant+Spearmen+Genitour to counter diverse enemy unit types. Goes Pilgrim then 2nd TC into Castle Age. Uses healing and damage bonuses of Castilian influence near holy sites.
name: Vortix's 2TC Serjeant & Genitour + Pilgrim - Copy for me to understand series
author: murtuk

notes: @abilities/repair.webp@@building_technology/blacksmith.webp@ and get @technology_military/bloomery.webp@ (both unit types utilize this)
Stop making units and rush castle if enemy gets archers

description: This build is designed for hybrid water maps, providing a strong and stable economy while establishing a clear advantage in the Feudal Age. It performs well against Castle builds and 2 TC builds. This advantage can be used for decisive Feudal aggression or converted into further economic growth. It is not ideal for full-scale naval battles.
name: 1 TC Hybrid Water
author: Syrik

notes: Proceed to the next Age with @civilization_flag/ant.webp@ . Worker setup remains unchanged at this point.

description: This build is well suited for multiplayer team games. I would not particularly recommend it for 1v1 matches. The main advantage of this build is the wide range of options it offers for adapting to different in-game situations. The core concept of this build is not my own creation; it is my adaptation of a build originally developed by the player Corvinus1.
name: 2 TC
author: Syrik

notes: Proceed to the next Age with @civilization_flag/ant.webp@ . Worker setup remains unchanged at this point.
Click up to feudal. I like to default to @civilization_flag/hos.webp@
Queue @technology_templar/safepassage.webp@ -> 2 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ -> @technology_templar/sanctuary.webp@ and then start making units. See guide for more.

I like to go @building_military/barracks.webp@ & @building_military/archery-range.webp@ into @building_technology/blacksmith.webp@ and add @building_military/stable.webp@ if necessary. Take map resources like @resource/deer.webp@ & @resource/boar.webp@ with @building_economy/mill.webp@ and tower up .

upgrade @technology_economy/horticulture.webp@ & @technology_economy/wheelbarrow.webp@, at the same time produce 2 @unit_templar/hospitaller_knight_age_2.webp@ & 2 @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ & 10 @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@
Eventually hit castle around 12-14 mins and make @unit_templar/templar_brother_age_3.webp@ and archer spam. Put 5 On stone for @landmark_templar/fortress.webp@
